narrative.headline: The 2020 Silverado 1500's most-reported trouble spots: engine and drivetrain
narrative.summary: Owners filed 678 complaints with NHTSA. Engine problems lead at 224 reports (33%), with power train close behind at 211 (31%). Brakes, the electrical system, and steering round out the list. The electrical-system complaints are the most severe, tied to 8 fires, 2 crashes, and 4 injuries.
